tools.name: check_message
tools.title: Check a message for fraud
tools.description: Analyze a suspicious text message, email, phone script, or URL for signs of fraud targeting Canadians. Returns a finding (HIGH RISK, BE CAREFUL, NO KNOWN WARNING FOUND — never 'safe'), the scam type, danger level, a plain-English explanation, STOP · VERIFY · CALL steps, and the results of live URL checks against Google Safe Browsing and VirusTotal. A clean technical result means only that no known threat was found; it does not prove legitimacy.

message.description: The full suspicious message, email text, phone script, or URL to analyze.

lang.description: Language for the diagnosis text. Defaults to English.

tools.name: list_recent_scams
tools.title: List recent Canadian scams
tools.description: List the current scam alerts Fraud Doctor tracks in Canada, including the channel used, the reporting source, and what to do about each one.

query.description: Optional keyword to filter alerts, for example 'parking', 'CRA', or 'QR'.

tools.name: get_reporting_info
tools.title: How to report fraud in Canada
tools.description: Get the official Canadian fraud reporting channels and next steps to take after being targeted by a scam.
